Extends decision_log/fieldwise-tier3-lift_2026-08-11.json (ticket 3) and decision_log/fieldwise-ticket6-fold_2026-08-12.json (ticket 6). Durable recording per CLAUDE.md §9.4. why: Phase 2 run d00fc75d wrote concept_refinement_summary.json with four unresolved scope conflicts and failed phase_02_gate semantic predicate g03_p06 (no_unresolved_scope_conflicts). The gate finding is correct about the artifact it inspected and wrong about the project: the material answering all four conflicts was already decided, but none of it was reachable by the skill that produced the artifact. concept-alignment-check declares exactly one Tier 3 read path, docs/tier3_project_instantiation/project_brief/, which at the time held only the three ticket-3 lifts of draft sections 1.1.x. The decided material sat in source_materials/operator_input_pack/, in consortium/capabilities.json, in working_assumptions.json and in this decision log — all outside the skill's reads_from. This record moves that material into project_brief/ so the concept surface the gate tests contains the evidence the project already has.

conflicts_addressed.evidence_now_in_project_brief: Input pack item 6 transferable-skills component (research integrity; open science and FAIR practice; generative-AI literacy; grant writing; IP and exploitation; project management; science communication), ACCEPTed by the operator 2026-08-11. Draft ¶181 Open Science. Draft §1.3 ¶183-194 eleven ELTE-to-fellow competences. Draft §2.2 ¶231-238 exploitation pathway and IP strategy as the valorisation substance.
conflicts_addressed.previously_unreachable_because: Item 6 lives in source_materials/; ¶181 and §1.3 were lifted to consortium/capabilities.json, not to project_brief/.

conflicts_addressed.requirement: A Career Development Plan established jointly by supervisor(s) and researcher and submitted as an early project deliverable.
conflicts_addressed.evidence_now_in_project_brief: Input pack item 6, ACCEPTed in full: six components, agreed M3, reviewed M6/M12/M16/M20, new deliverable D1.3 Career Development Plan at M3 owned by FELLOW and SUPERVISOR. Item 4's co-supervisor amendment adds that the plan is signed by both supervisors and the fellow.

not_written: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase2_concept_refinement/concept_refinement_summary.json — a run-produced Tier 4 artifact. Hand-editing it to mark the conflicts resolved would be overwritten on the next run and would assert a resolution the concept surface did not support. The amendment is made at Tier 3, where the evidence belongs, and Phase 2 is re-run.

skill_catalog.yaml — concept-alignment-check's reads_from is unchanged. Widening it to source_materials/ was considered and declined: source_materials/ holds raw operator input (the pack is 2,788 lines), not curated concept material, and resolving call conflicts against an un-curated source would move the concept surface out of project_brief/ without saying so.

status_assignments.Confirmed: Draft-lifted prose (verbatim, cited to ¶ ranges) and operator-decided content where the input pack records an explicit ACCEPT with a date.
status_assignments.Assumed: Primary supervision of an ELTE MSc thesis, which may require a formal ELTE affiliation the fellow will not automatically hold. Open action with the Faculty of Informatics; the fallback (co-supervision plus the module unit) is stated in the record.
status_assignments.Unresolved: Three, each named in the record rather than omitted: the item 4 C6 escalation-route defect, where the accepted route ran past the supervisor to a post he himself holds; the EI-04 Charter mapping, which rests on D1.3 and institutional policy with no external accreditation; and the five deferred item 12 capacity fields plus the ELTE mentoring structure.

explicitly_not_claimed: ELTE does NOT hold the HR Excellence in Research (HRS4R) award. The operator confirmed this on 2026-08-11 (input pack C8) and the claim was removed permanently. The record states the removal so a later editor cannot reintroduce it from the superseded candidate wording. An earlier candidate asserted the status while the answer beside it read 'unknown'; carrying it forward would have put a false, one-click-checkable institutional claim about the host into a submitted proposal.
open_items_carried_forward: K11 — the input pack notes that D1.3 carries no KPI, leaving the item 5 list one short of the deliverable coverage it claims. Proposed: 'Career Development Plan agreed by M3 and reviewed at all four steering points' -> D1.3. Affects Phase 5/6, not phase_02_gate.

The raised EI-06 teaching workload (module unit co-design plus primary MSc supervision plus PhD field-component co-supervision) does not fit comfortably in the 3.0 cross-cutting person-months. Either raise cross-cutting or state in §3.1 that teaching sits within the training allocation.
CC-07's six-month placement ceiling is used in full; no headroom if the plan later needs a seventh month.
